# vMLX 1.6.70

- SSD cache lookup: avoid redundant cache-type scans when stored layer metadata already declares the cache type.
- Native MTP cache restoration: validate the complete token-prefix identity when restoring companion state after disk refault, including when block identifiers change.
- Diagnostics: correct scheduler timing accounting for multiple outputs in one step and add opt-in bounded verifier profiling.

Experimental MTP performance options remain disabled by default. This release does not claim sustained prose speedups across all models or quantizations.

Choose the Tahoe DMG for macOS 26 or the Sequoia DMG for macOS 15.

Known limitation: Qwen Flash-Next can misdescribe video frames. This release does not resolve those video-perception errors.
